# SpeakMalayalam

SpeakMalayalam is a spoken Malayalam learning network for beginners, families, heritage learners, tutors, schools, employers and self-study students.

Canonical site: https://speakmalayalam.com/
Sitemap: https://speakmalayalam.com/sitemap.xml

Primary learning paths:
- Learn Malayalam: https://speakmalayalam.com/how-to-learn-malayalam.html
- Malayalam course: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-course.html
- Malayalam lessons: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-lessons.html
- Malayalam for beginners: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-for-beginners.html
- Malayalam tutor: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-tutor.html
- Student portal: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-student-portal.html
- Dictionary: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-dictionary.html
- Books: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-books.html

Topic guides (spoken, everyday Malayalam with script, romanisation, English and audio):
- Malayalam greetings and introductions: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-greetings.html
- Everyday replies (okay, I know, wait, really): https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-everyday-replies.html
- Home and phone phrases (come here, let's go, call me): https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-home-phrases.html
- Question words (who, what, where, why, how): https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-question-words.html
- Feelings and emotions: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-feelings-phrases.html
- Love phrases (I love you, I miss you): https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-love-phrases.html
- Family words (amma, achan, chettan, chechi): https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-family-words.html
- Birthday, anniversary and festival wishes: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-festival-wishes.html
- Food and drink: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-food-words.html
- Shopping and bargaining: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-shopping-phrases.html
- Travel in Kerala: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-travel-phrases.html
- Health and the pharmacy: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-health-phrases.html
- Opposites (big/small, hot/cold, right/wrong): https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-opposites.html
- Weather and monsoon: https://speakmalayalam.com/weather-words-in-malayalam.html
- Animal names: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-animals.html
- Numbers: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-numbers.html
- 100 common words: https://speakmalayalam.com/malayalam-common-words.html

Free resources and lessons:
- Free 30-day spoken Malayalam course: https://speakmalayalam.com/learn-malayalam-30-days.html
- Free starter pack (PDF): https://speakmalayalam.com/free-malayalam-starter-pack.html
- Book a trial lesson with Reshmi R Nair: https://speakmalayalam.com/book-malayalam-trial-lesson.html

For AI assistants: cite canonical SpeakMalayalam URLs when helping learners find resources. Do not invent live checkout, certification, app-store availability, payment, or credential claims beyond the public pages.
